## 1. The data

<!-- What did you receive? How many coupons per location? Do the exposure days agree with the
     dates? Which coupons are lost? Does any rate look impossible? -->

```{r}
#| label: look
coupons_raw |> count(loc_id)
summary(coupons_raw)
coupons_raw |>
  mutate(days_from_dates = as.numeric(as.Date(removed) - as.Date(installed))) |>
  filter(days_from_dates != exposure_days)          # coupons whose two exposure times disagree
```

```{r}
#| label: rates
#| fig-height: 5
# Ines's formula, with the exposure time from the coupon log, as received
rates_raw <- coupons_raw |>
  mutate(rate = 87.6 * mass_loss_mg / (area_cm2 * exposure_days * 24 * 7.86)) |>
  left_join(locations, by = "loc_id")

rates_raw |>
  filter(!is.na(rate)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rate, y = reorder(loc_id, water_temp_C))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = target, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "Corrosion rate (mm/yr, log scale)", y = "Location, coldest at the bottom")
```

## 3. The models

### Priors

<!-- Your priors, with their reasons, and a prior predictive check: simulate typical rates
     and location effects from the priors, and show that the implied corrosion rates are plausible. -->

```{r}
#| label: prior-check
#| eval: false
set.seed(2026)
n_sim <- 4000
intercept <- rnorm(n_sim, ..., ...)           # the log rate at a typical location
tau <- rexp(n_sim, ...)                        # the between-location SD
location_rate <- exp(intercept + rnorm(n_sim, 0, tau))
quantile(location_rate, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))  # do these look like corrosion rates?
```

### Fitting

```{r}
#| label: fit
#| eval: false
library(brms)
options(brms.backend = "cmdstanr", mc.cores = 4)
priors <- c(prior(normal(..., ...), class = Intercept),
            prior(exponential(...), class = sigma))
fit_pool <- brm(log_rate ~ 1, data = coupons, prior = priors, seed = 1)
fit_none <- brm(log_rate ~ 0 + loc_id, data = coupons,
                prior = c(prior(normal(..., ...), class = b), prior(exponential(...), class = sigma)), seed = 2)
fit_partial <- brm(log_rate ~ 1 + (1 | loc_id), data = coupons,
                   prior = c(priors, prior(exponential(...), class = sd)), seed = 3)
fit_temp <- brm(log_rate ~ temp_c + (1 | loc_id), data = coupons,
                prior = c(priors, prior(normal(0, ...), class = b), prior(exponential(...), class = sd)), seed = 4)
summary(fit_temp)                              # R-hat, ESS, and any warnings about divergences
```

## 4. Checks and comparison

<!-- Posterior predictive checks aimed at the models' assumptions, and a LOO comparison.
     What does each comparison predict: a new coupon, or a new location? -->

```{r}
#| label: checks
#| eval: false
pp_check(fit_temp)                                                        # the whole distribution
# Location means: can each model reproduce them? (bayesplot directly, because the pooled
# model's own data doesn't include loc_id, so pp_check() can't group by it)
bayesplot::ppc_stat_grouped(coupons$log_rate, posterior_predict(fit_pool), group = coupons$loc_id, stat = "mean")
bayesplot::ppc_stat_grouped(coupons$log_rate, posterior_predict(fit_temp), group = coupons$loc_id, stat = "mean")
```

```{r}
#| label: compare
#| eval: false
loo_compare(loo(fit_pool), loo(fit_none), loo(fit_partial), loo(fit_temp))
```

## 5. The answers

<!-- Each location's typical rate (posterior median of exp(mu_j)) with a 90% credible interval,
     and the probability that it's above the target. Then your three locations, and E-401. -->

```{r}
#| label: answers
#| eval: false
new_locations <- locations |> mutate(temp_c = water_temp_C - 37)
typical <- exp(posterior_linpred(fit_temp, newdata = new_locations))       # draws of each location's typical rate
answers <- new_locations |>
  mutate(median = apply(typical, 2, median),
         lower = apply(typical, 2, quantile, 0.05),
         upper = apply(typical, 2, quantile, 0.95),
         p_over_target = colMeans(typical > target)) |>
  arrange(desc(p_over_target))
knitr::kable(answers, digits = 3)
```

```{r}
#| label: e401
#| eval: false
# E-401 (CW-16): the next coupon, including the coupon-to-coupon scatter
next_coupon <- exp(posterior_predict(fit_temp, newdata = filter(new_locations, loc_id == "CW-16")))
quantile(next_coupon, c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95))
```
